A review in two pages

Page two carries the results: the throughput went up by a fifth on the first workload and by nothing at all on the second, which is the whole finding and the only paragraph worth keeping from either page.

A table of twenty-six rows follows in the real thing. The conclusion is that the change is worth taking if your workload looks like the first one and is a waste of an afternoon if it looks like the second.
